confirm.description: This creates {{count}} employees, each with a current salary record. Existing employees are not changed. If anything has changed since the check and a row is no longer valid, nothing is imported.

prepare.title: File format
prepare.limits: Up to {{rows}} employees and {{size}} MB per file, UTF-8 encoded, with a header row.
prepare.allOrNothing: All or nothing: if any row has a problem, no employees are imported.
prepare.createOnly: Only creates new employees. Existing employees are never updated, so each employee code and email must be new.
prepare.effectiveFrom: Salaries are recorded as effective from the day of the import.

rule.employee_code: Unique, up to 50 characters. Must not start with INC-, which the app uses for codes it generates.
rule.email: A valid email address not used by any other employee.
rule.department: Name of an existing department (not case-sensitive). Add new departments on the Departments page first.
rule.country: Country name or 2-letter ISO code, e.g. India or IN.
rule.notice_period_start_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty for active employees. Required for notice_period, and not after today. Optional for inactive.
rule.notice_period_end_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty for active employees. Required for notice_period: today or later, and within 365 days of the start. For inactive, not after today.
rule.currency: 3-letter code that must match the country, e.g. INR for India.
rule.annual_ctc: Amount of 0 or more with up to 2 decimals, without commas or symbols, e.g. 1800000.00.
